title: VCNIA Trace Record
description: A Trace Record is the foundational Existence Proof object in VCNIA. It records that a contribution, output, idea, action, or transformation existed at a specific time and context.

type.description: The fixed event type for a VCNIA trace record.

trace_id.description: A unique identifier for the trace.

creator_id.description: The human, AI agent, system, repository, or process that created or registered the trace.

timestamp.description: The time when the trace was created or registered, expressed in ISO 8601 date-time format.

content_hash.description: Optional hash of the trace content, such as a SHA-256 hash. This is optional in v0.1 but may become required in later versions.

source_uri.description: Optional URI pointing to the source, repository, document, platform, or record where the trace can be referenced.

provenance.description: Information about the origin, source, and registration method of the trace.

source.description: The origin or source category of the trace.

method.description: The method by which the trace was created or registered.

parent_trace_ids.description: Optional list of parent traces that influenced or preceded this trace.

derived_from.description: Optional list of external references, source materials, or prior works from which this trace was derived.

context.description: Optional contextual information about the environment, project, task, or situation in which the trace was created.

signature.description: Optional cryptographic or semi-cryptographic signature information.

public_key_ref.description: Optional reference to the public key or verification material.
